Give Your Child the Strongest Start
An exceptional education for children aged 3–11, where academic excellence, strong character and a love of learning grow together.
At Edullect Academy, we believe every child is an amanah — a precious trust, full of potential, purpose and promise.
As Havering’s only purpose-built Muslim faith-based school, we provide a safe, nurturing and ambitious environment where every child is known, valued and encouraged to flourish.
Our approach brings together academic excellence, strong character and faith-inspired values. Through high-quality teaching, an engaging curriculum and high expectations, pupils develop the knowledge, confidence, curiosity and resilience they need to succeed in school and in life.
Office Hours: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM

Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)

Primary

Our school community is built on eight guiding values—our Core 8
At Edullect Academy, we believe that every human being has inherent worth and purpose. Our foundation is rooted in a deep spiritual belief in God (Allah) as the Creator of all things—seen and unseen—and in the timeless guidance brought through His messengers. These teachings promote justice, compassion, integrity, and the equality of all people.
A key inspiration for our philosophy is drawn from the Quran (49:13), which says:
“O humanity! We created you from a single male and female, and made you into nations and tribes so that you may know one another. Truly, the most honoured of you in the sight of God is the most righteous. Surely, God is All-Knowing, All-Aware.”
This message speaks not only to Muslims but to all of humanity. It reflects our belief that diversity is a strength, and that through mutual respect, shared values, and a commitment to good character, we build a stronger, more compassionate society.Edullect Academy welcomes pupils of all faiths and of none. While our ethos is shaped by Islamic principles, we promote an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and included.
Our Educational Philosophy
Edullect Academy’s educational philosophy integrates the "Core 8" Islamic values—compassion, faith, forgiveness, generosity, honesty, inclusion, modesty, and respect—with a strong commitment to academic excellence and personal growth. By aligning these values with both Islamic teachings and British values, the Academy fosters a nurturing, inclusive, and respectful environment. Through evidence-based pedagogy, culturally responsive teaching, and a rigorous curriculum, students are encouraged to think critically, act and lead ethically, and contribute meaningfully to society. Edullect values student voice and diversity, preparing learners to navigate complex global challenges with knowledge, faith, integrity, resilience, and purpose.
The Core 8: Living Our Shared Values
At the heart of our community are eight guiding values—our Core 8—which form the basis of character development and positive contribution to society. These values align with both Islamic teachings and universal human values:
Compassion
Showing empathy, care, and concern for others.
Faith
Developing a deeper understanding of one’s own beliefs and respecting the beliefs of others. For Muslims, this includes practicing Islamic ideals with sincerity and purpose.
Forgiveness
Cultivating patience, understanding, and the ability to forgive.
Generosity
Giving time, kindness, and support to others selflessly.
Honesty
Acting with integrity, truthfulness, and a sense of moral responsibility.
Inclusion
Embracing diversity and actively involving those who may be different from ourselves.
Modesty
Practicing humility in action, appearance, and thought.
Respect
Valuing every individual and engaging with others in a spirit of dignity and openness.
These values are not just taught—they are lived. They help shape our interactions, guide our teaching, and create a nurturing atmosphere where everyone can thrive.
Faith in Action, Open to All
Our faith-based approach offers a strong moral compass, grounded in the Quran and the example of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). For our Muslim community, this spiritual foundation helps us live a life of gratitude, balance, and purpose—through family life, education, healthy living, acts of kindness, and daily routines that reflect worship in everyday actions.
Yet, these values resonate universally. Whether a pupil follows a different faith or none, our philosophy encourages all learners to seek meaning, contribute positively to the world, and grow as ethical, compassionate individuals.
Embracing British Values
As a British school, we actively promote British Values, ensuring all pupils become respectful, responsible citizens. These values naturally complement our Core 8 and reflect our commitment to a cohesive and respectful society:
At Edullect Academy, we are more than a school—we are a diverse learning community where values and learning go hand-in-hand, and where every child is guided to develop a strong sense of identity, purpose, and belonging.

Raising Confident, Compassionate Leaders and Global Citizens with Integrity...
“ We aim to deliver education of an outstanding quality that fosters academic, moral, and spiritual excellence. ”
At Edullect Academy, we believe every child is full of limitless potential—brimming with curiosity, creativity, and the capacity to grow into a confident, kind and capable individual. Our school exists to nurture that potential through an outstanding, well-rounded education that focuses not only on academic success, but also on strong moral character and spiritual well-being.
We warmly welcome you to explore what makes Edullect Academy the ideal choice for families seeking a vibrant, forward-thinking, and inclusive learning environment for children aged 3 to 11.
Our aim is clear: to provide a nurturing and inspiring school experience that develops the mind, builds the heart, and uplifts the spirit—preparing your child not just for school, but for life.
At Edullect Academy, we make a heartfelt promise to every parent: your child will be nurtured, challenged, and inspired—academically, morally, and spiritually.
Our mission is to provide more than just outstanding education. We cultivate confident, compassionate leaders—young people with integrity, purpose, and a genuine love for humanity. Guided by our Core 8 universal (Islamic) values, your child will grow in character as well as knowledge, developing the moral compass needed to navigate life with wisdom and empathy.
In our innovative, tech-enriched purpose-built learning spaces—including our state-of-the-art AI & Tech room—students learn through discovery, collaboration, and creativity. We ignite curiosity, encourage critical thinking, and help children unlock their full potential.
At Edullect Academy, we don’t just teach—we inspire. We empower children to believe in themselves, serve others, and lead with heart.
Together, let’s shape a generation ready to change the world—with knowledge, faith, and purpose.
Message from Head of Primary
As the Head of Nursery and Primary at Edullect Academy, I am deeply committed to providing an environment where your child can thrive academically, socially, and spiritually. With years of experience in both education and leadership, I ensure that every aspect of our school fosters academic excellence and upholds strong (Islamic -universal) values.
My team and I are passionate about nurturing each child’s potential, supporting their growth, and inspiring them to become confident, compassionate learners. We work tirelessly to ensure that all students receive the highest standard of care, attention, and education in a safe and welcoming environment.
Rest assured, your child’s journey at Edullect Academy will be guided by an experienced and dedicated leadership team, fully focused on their success—both in the classroom and in life.
Rajia Mukit
What Makes Edullect Academy Different?
We understand that choosing the right school for your child is one of the most important decisions you’ll ever make. At Edullect Academy, six core features set us apart and make us a first choice for families who value excellence, purpose-driven education, and meaningful character development:
Expert Education Leadership
Our school is led by a team of passionate and highly qualified education and industry experts. These leaders bring diverse knowledge and insight, actively shaping the culture of our school to ensure it is positive, enriching, and forward-looking. We are committed to hiring and developing skilled, passionate teachers who know how to engage young minds—and we embrace digital technology to enhance learning, promote progress, and create a joyful classroom experience every day.
The Core 8: Embedding Islamic Values for All
Character and values are at the heart of everything we do. At Edullect Academy, we are deeply rooted in our eight Core (Islamic) Values—Compassion, Faith, Forgiveness, Generosity, Honesty, Inclusion, Modesty, and Respect. These values are actively embedded throughout the curriculum and school life. While rooted in the Islamic tradition, they reflect universal human principles that enrich the lives of all pupils, regardless of their faith. Through these values, we aim to raise thoughtful, respectful, and empathetic individuals who contribute positively at school, at home, and in society.
Islamic Studies with Depth and Relevance
For our Muslim students, Quranic studies, Arabic, and Islamic education are central parts of the curriculum. Delivered by trained specialists, these subjects are taught with both reverence and relevance—helping students connect deeply with their faith while gaining an understanding of Islam’s contributions to the world past and present. As our students grow, they will have the opportunity to pursue advanced Islamic study pathways, including ‘alamiyyah and hifz programmes.
STAM Curriculum & Innovation
We’re passionate about sparking imagination and developing future-ready learners. At Edullect Academy, we go beyond traditional learning to focus on STAM (Science, Technology, Arts, and Mathematics) subjects through hands-on activities, engaging projects, and creative exploration. Our aim is to ignite children’s natural love for learning, helping them dream big, think critically, and develop the confidence to solve real-world problems.
Partnership with Parents
We believe education is a shared journey—and parents are our most valued partners. From day one, you’ll be welcomed into a collaborative and transparent school community. Parents have the opportunity to serve on key committees—ranging from curriculum development to safeguarding—and be actively involved in shaping the future of the school. Together, we’ll ensure your child thrives academically, socially, and emotionally.
An Inclusive, Welcoming Environment
Although Edullect Academy is grounded in Islamic ethos, we warmly welcome children of all backgrounds and faiths. Just as faith-based schools like Catholic or Church of England schools embrace inclusivity, so do we. Non-Muslim students are invited to participate in shared values and cultural activities, and may opt out of religious studies in favour of other enriching subjects. Our commitment is to help every child feel seen, supported, and inspired.

Ofsted Inspection Update – 2026
Our second full Ofsted inspection took place over three days, from 19 to 21 May, and we are pleased to share that it went extremely well.
The new inspection framework is significantly more thorough and detailed than previous approaches. Instead of issuing a single overall judgement, inspectors now evaluate schools across seven common inspection areas, with additional scrutiny for nursery provision and sixth form provision where applicable. Each area receives a carefully considered grade accompanied by a detailed narrative explaining the findings.
As an independent school, Edullect Academy must also meet the Independent School Standards (ISS). This is a rigorous process in its own right, requiring schools to demonstrate consistently high standards across all aspects of provision — including the quality of education, safeguarding, leadership, and the suitability of the school premises and resources.
We are extremely pleased with the inspection outcome, which reflects the quality, ambition and high standards we have established so early in the school’s journey. While the official report has not yet been published, we will share it with our community as soon as it becomes publicly available.

Our school is rooted in values of compassion, excellence, and community
Edullect Academy began in July 2018 as a non-profit initiative to support children with high-quality Quran and Islamic education. Founded by Shah Sher Ali in the London Borough of Havering, the academy originally offered after-school classes in local school classrooms, before transitioning to an online platform during the Covid-19 pandemic. This shift allowed us to enhance the quality of teaching while offering greater flexibility to families.
With a low pupil-teacher ratio of 4:1 and a focus on individual progress, our dedicated team—including qualified teachers and experienced volunteers—has nurtured a small, close-knit learning environment. Over 90% of our students return year after year, a testament to the trust and satisfaction of families in our care.
In 2023, Edullect Academy took a bold step toward a bigger vision: to establish a chain of independent schools, starting with the first in Havering. As part of this transition, Quran and Islamic studies were moved to a new, fully independent platform—Edullect Madrasa—now led by co-founder Hafiz Shah Ali Faez. This madrasa has already seen remarkable achievements, including students completing Hifz and earning ijazah in Quranic recitation.
“In 2023, Edullect Academy took a bold step toward a bigger vision: to establish a chain of independent schools, starting with the first in the London Borough of Havering.”
Edullect Academy is now an independent educational institution, specialising in Nursery, Primary, and Secondary education. While rooted in values of compassion, excellence, and community, the Academy’s vision has evolved to meet the broader educational needs of families. With its first school launching in the London Borough of Havering,Edullect Academy aims to become a leading independent school chain in the UK, with plans to open more schools across the country—and an ambition to expand internationally. Whether you're seeking a nurturing environment grounded in strong values or a school that truly invests in your child’s academic and personal growth, Edullect Academy offers a future-focused education where every child is seen, supported, and inspired to succeed.
From the Founder
With over three decades of experience in the education sector, Shah Sher Ali, founder of Edullect Academy, has dedicated his life to the growth and development of young minds who will positively impact the society. His journey spans teaching, leadership, and community service, all rooted in a deep commitment to educational excellence and social impact.
Now, bringing together a lifetime of skills, knowledge, and personal resources, Shah is focused on building a unique centre of educational excellence—a place where learning is not only about academic success, but also about nurturing values, faith, and a sense of purpose. His vision is clear: to create an environment where children grow into confident, compassionate, and capable individuals—leaders with integrity—ready to serve and lead in an ever-changing world.
At the heart of Edullect Academy is a mission to serve humanity—through education that uplifts, empowers, and inspires.
